Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Marketing Specialist position in Barcelona. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in SEO, content, and web design, I am excited about the opportunity to help clients grow their businesses through innovative online marketing solutions.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites for clients. I have also developed my own project, mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. My experience in sales is limited, but I am highly motivated to develop my skills in a dynamic, multicultural environment.

I am a native Turkish speaker with professional English and Dutch at B1 level, and I am currently improving my Dutch. I am eager to relocate to Barcelona and take advantage of the relocation package offered.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your team.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Digital Marketing Specialist position in Barcelona. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I am eager to bring my skills to your international team and help clients thrive in the digital space.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience in on-page SEO, keyword research, and content creation. I have successfully improved organic visibility for client websites by implementing targeted SEO strategies and building WordPress sites with Elementor and Astra. My ability to analyze performance data using tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs has allowed me to make data-driven decisions that enhance campaign effectiveness.

Beyond my professional experience, I have developed mirook.com, a project where I applied advanced SEO and GEO techniques, including structured data and entity optimization, to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project has honed my skills in technical SEO and content strategy, and I am passionate about leveraging these skills to help businesses grow.

While my professional background is primarily in digital marketing, I have developed strong communication and relationship-building skills through client-facing work. I am a proactive learner, always eager to expand my knowledge and adapt to new tools and platforms. I am confident that my technical expertise and dedication to delivering results make me a strong fit for this role.

I am particularly drawn to the opportunity to work in Barcelona, a city known for its vibrant culture and excellent work-life balance. I am ready to relocate and fully immerse myself in this exciting opportunity.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your team and helping your clients succeed.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core skills
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Web & build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)
